full_judgment: 2. The Petitioner subscriber of the Memorandum and contributory shareholder also cites an irreversible process of the Company's decline as an incorporated entity into one that at best may be termed as a sole proprietorship. It is evident that the Company was incorporated on 25-3-1998 with a view primarily to set up a food and fruit juice processing plant and selling the manufactured products both at home and abroad. The initial corporate activity of tile Company is evident in its purchase of 18.15 decimals of land corresponding to Mouja-Kolomeshor, Khatian No. Old-154, SA-154, Plot No. Old-591, Current-807 at a consideration of Taka 1,00,000 by Sale Deed No. 15301 dated 24-8-1998 registered with the Sub Registry Office, Gazipur.
